title: EE60053: High Voltage And Insulation Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Production and measurements of high A. C. voltages, high DC voltages, impulse
voltages and impulse currents. Breakdown phenomena in solid, liquid and gaseous
